praise: You stayed with your maths for 24 minutes and got 37 out of 42. In 6 9/12 − 3 1/12 your answer 3 8/12 was right; it only needed one more step.

math.approach: With mixed numbers you work on the whole numbers and the fractions separately, which is a good plan. Twice the sign got mixed up: in 3 10/12 − 2 2/12 you added the twelfths (10 + 2) instead of taking away, and in 3 + 1/4 you took a quarter away instead of adding it.
math.note: Before you start, put a finger on the sign and say it out loud: plus or minus. When a question says "simplify", look for a number that divides top and bottom: 8/12 → divide both by 4 → 2/3.
